items.summary: 《利用祖先重组图恢复古人类基因渗入的特征》：该研究提出基于祖先重组图的新方法，用于检测现代人类基因组中源自古人类的基因片段。值得阅读，因其为理解人类演化中的基因交流提供了更精确的分析工具，方法创新且发表于顶级期刊。
items.title: Recovering signatures of archaic hominin introgression using ancestral recombination graphs

items.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:sec>
                    <jats:title>Objectives</jats:title>
                    <jats:p>This paper uses deciduous dental morphology to evaluate the spatial structure of the Archaic period site of Phaleron (Athens, Greece) with the goal of identifying possible biological kin‐ or community structuring of the burial ground.</jats:p>
                  </jats:sec>
                  <jats:sec>
                    <jats:title>Materials and Methods</jats:title>
                    <jats:p>Deciduous morphological data (77 total root‐trait combinations) were collected by the author using published standards for 231 preadult individuals from Phaleron. After pre‐analysis data treatments evaluating the effects of age, sex, and inter‐trait correlation, remaining variables were compared among burial subsectors using Mean Measure of Divergence statistics, with statistical significance assessed following both standard protocols and with bootstrapping methods.</jats:p>
                  </jats:sec>
                  <jats:sec>
                    <jats:title>Results</jats:title>
                    <jats:p>Results are consistent with, but not identical to, those presented using permanent dental morphology, with deciduous data presenting stronger evidence of spatial structuring. This suggests that the same principles governing grave placement applied to both adults and preadults, which I argue reflects biological kinship as a structuring principle of Archaic period burial grounds.</jats:p>
                  </jats:sec>
                  <jats:sec>
                    <jats:title>Discussion</jats:title>
                    <jats:p>This paper makes three contributions: (1) enhances understanding of ancient Greek burial practices, particularly of the non‐elite individuals who lived during the critical centuries of Athenian political development, (2) demonstrates the complementary value of using both deciduous and permanent dentition in analyses of biological distance, and (3) presents the first large sample of deciduous trait frequencies from ancient Greece, thus informing future comparative studies.</jats:p>
                  </jats:sec>
items.summary: 《利用乳牙形态重建希腊古风时期法勒隆墓地前成年个体墓葬的空间组织与墓地结构》：该研究通过分析231例前成年个体的乳牙形态特征，揭示墓地空间分布与生物亲缘关系的关联，为理解古希腊非精英群体的埋葬习俗及雅典政治发展关键时期的社会结构提供了新证据，同时首次提供古希腊乳牙特征的大样本数据，对生物距离分析方法的互补价值具有重要参考意义。
items.title: Reconstruction of Spatial Organization and Cemetery Structure of Preadult Burials at the Phaleron Burial Ground (Archaic Athens, Greece) Using Deciduous Dental Morphology

items.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:sec>
                    <jats:title>Objective</jats:title>
                    <jats:p>
                      This study provides new dental phenotypic data on the Aurignacian mandible Les Rois 2 (southwestern France). A former study of its dental morphology concluded that its taxonomic assignment to either
                      <jats:styled-content style="fixed-case">
                        <jats:italic>Homo sapiens</jats:italic>
                      </jats:styled-content>
                      or
                      <jats:italic>Homo neanderthalensis</jats:italic>
                      was “uncertain” and could reflect a recent Neanderthal ancestry of this specimen. An alternative explanation was that Aurignacian people from Les Rois were
                      <jats:styled-content style="fixed-case">
                        <jats:italic>H. sapiens</jats:italic>
                      </jats:styled-content>
                      displaying plesiomorphic features, extending the biological variation seen among modern populations. Here, we propose a reassessment of Les Rois 2 taxonomic status through the study of its dental morphological features.
                    </jats:p>
                  </jats:sec>
                  <jats:sec>
                    <jats:title>Material and Methods</jats:title>
                    <jats:p>
                      Our analyses include micro‐tomographic data of a large comparative sample of
                      <jats:italic>H. neanderthalensis</jats:italic>
                      , Pleistocene and Holocene
                      <jats:styled-content style="fixed-case">
                        <jats:italic>H. sapiens</jats:italic>
                      </jats:styled-content>
                      . We analyze dental metrics, 3D dental tissue proportions (AET and RET), Enamel Dentin Junction (EDJ) nonmetric trait variations, and lower premolar EDJ size and shape with 3D geometric morphometrics.
                    </jats:p>
                  </jats:sec>
                  <jats:sec>
                    <jats:title>Results</jats:title>
                    <jats:p>
                      The Les Rois 2 specimen displays dental features placing it at the limit of the range of variation of Holocene populations, but consistent with the morphology of Late Pleistocene
                      <jats:styled-content style="fixed-case">
                        <jats:italic>H. sapiens</jats:italic>
                      </jats:styled-content>
                      . Our analyses also show that Les Rois 2 lacks the derived
                      <jats:italic>H. neanderthalensis</jats:italic>
                      morphological trait.
                    </jats:p>
                  </jats:sec>
                  <jats:sec>
                    <jats:title>Discussion</jats:title>
                    <jats:p>
                      Our study shows that the taxonomic attribution of Les Rois 2 is more consistent with
                      <jats:styled-content style="fixed-case">
                        <jats:italic>H. sapiens</jats:italic>
                      </jats:styled-content>
                      than with
                      <jats:italic>H. neanderthalensis</jats:italic>
                      , while acknowledging that the specimen displays plesiomorphic features rare among recent
                      <jats:styled-content style="fixed-case">
                        <jats:italic>H. sapiens</jats:italic>
                      </jats:styled-content>
                      populations. These findings highlight the larger phenotypic variation displayed by Early Upper Paleolithic populations and contribute to a better understanding of the morphology of Aurignacian makers.
                    </jats:p>
                  </jats:sec>
items.summary: 《法国奥瑞纳下颌骨Les Rois 2的牙齿特征：新数据与分类学再评估》：该研究通过显微断层扫描和三维几何形态测量，重新评估了这件关键化石的归属，发现其牙齿形态更符合智人而非尼安德特人，但保留少数原始特征。值得阅读，因为它为早期旧石器时代晚期人群的形态变异提供了新证据，有助于厘清奥瑞纳文化制造者的生物学身份。
items.title: The Dentition of the Aurignacian Mandible Les Rois 2, France: New Data and Taxonomic Reassessment

items.summary: 《科学基于假设，哲学能确保这些假设是正确的》：这篇论文探讨了科学赖以成立的隐含假设，以及哲学如何通过批判性反思来检验这些假设的合理性。值得一读，因为它为理解科学与哲学的互补关系提供了清晰框架，尤其适合关注科学方法论基础的读者。
items.title: Science is based on assumptions. Philosophy can make sure they’re the right ones.

items.abstract: <jats:p>Lipoproteins are essential for lipid transport in all bilaterians. A single Apolipoprotein B (ApoB) molecule is the inseparable structural scaffold of each ApoB-containing lipoprotein (B-lps), which are responsible for transporting lipids to peripheral tissues. The cellular mechanisms that regulate ApoB and B-lp production, secretion, transport, and degradation remain to be fully defined. In humans, elevated levels of vascular B-lps play a causative role in cardiovascular disease. Previously, we have detailed that human B-lp biology is remarkably conserved in the zebrafish using an in vivo chemiluminescent reporter of ApoB (LipoGlo) that does not disrupt ApoB function. Thus, the LipoGlo model is an ideal system for identifying novel mechanisms of ApoB modulation and, due to the ability of zebrafish to generate many progeny, is particularly amenable to large-scale phenotypic drug screening. Here, we report a screen of roughly 3000 compounds that identified 49 unique ApoB-lowering hits. Nineteen hits passed orthogonal screening criteria, and seven were subjected to extensive phenotyping. A licorice root component, enoxolone, significantly lowered B-lps only in animals that express a functional allele of the nuclear hormone receptor Hepatocyte Nuclear Factor 4⍺ (HNF4⍺). Consistent with this result, inhibitors of HNF4⍺ also reduce B-lp levels. These data demonstrate that mechanism(s) of action can be rapidly determined from a whole-animal zebrafish phenotypic screen. Given the well-documented role of HNF4⍺ in human B-lp biology, these data validate the LipoGlo screening platform for identifying small-molecule modulators of B-lps that play a critical role in a leading cause of worldwide mortality.</jats:p>
items.summary: 《全动物表型药物筛选鉴定致动脉粥样硬化脂蛋白的抑制因子》：该研究利用斑马鱼LipoGlo模型筛选约3000种化合物，发现49种降低ApoB脂蛋白的候选药物，并锁定甘草成分enoxolone通过HNF4⍺通路发挥作用。值得阅读，因其验证了全动物筛选平台在心血管疾病药物发现中的高效性，为靶向B-lp调控提供新策略。
items.title: A whole-animal phenotypic drug screen identifies suppressors of atherogenic lipoproteins

items.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    Endolysosomal dysfunction is a hallmark of Alzheimer’s disease and related tauopathies, yet underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. This study investigates the role of sphingolipid metabolism in maintaining endolysosomal membrane integrity and its impact on tau aggregation and toxicity in
                    <jats:italic>Caenorhabditis elegans</jats:italic>
                    and human cell culture models. Fluorescence recovery after photobleaching and C-Laurdan dye imaging revealed that silencing sphingolipid metabolism genes reduced endolysosomal vesicle membrane fluidity, increasing their rupture. The accumulation of aggregated tau in endolysosomal vesicles further aggravated endomembrane rigidification and damage, and promoted seeded tau aggregation, potentially by facilitating the escape of tau seeds from the endolysosomal system. Supplementation with unsaturated fatty acids improved membrane fluidity, suppressing endolysosomal rupture and seeded tau aggregation in cell models, and alleviating tau-associated neurotoxicity in
                    <jats:italic>C. elegans</jats:italic>
                    . Together, this study provides mechanistic insight into how perturbation of sphingolipid metabolism promotes endolysosomal membrane damage and contributes to the escape of aggregated tau from this compartment, suggesting that restoration of membrane fluidity may represent a strategy to limit tau propagation and toxicity.
                  </jats:p>
items.summary: 《鞘脂代谢紊乱通过内溶酶体膜硬化与破裂促进tau蛋白播种》：该研究揭示鞘脂代谢异常如何导致内溶酶体膜流动性下降、破裂，进而加剧tau蛋白聚集与传播，并通过补充不饱和脂肪酸恢复膜流动性来缓解毒性，为理解阿尔茨海默病机制及潜在干预策略提供了新视角，值得关注。
items.title: Disruption of sphingolipid metabolism promotes tau seeding through endolysosomal membrane rigidification and rupture

items.abstract: <jats:p>The evolutionary change in the mode of locomotion is often a major evolutionary event, triggering diversification. Sideways locomotion is a defining feature of true crabs (Brachyura) and may have contributed to their ecological success. Yet, the evolutionary origin of this unique behavior remains unknown. Here, we show that the prevalence of sideways locomotion in true crabs reflects a single evolutionary origin from a forward-moving ancestor. Our behavioral analysis of 50 live crab species indicates that crab locomotion can be broadly separated into two predominant modes, sideways and forward locomotion. The phylogenetic comparative analysis revealed a single origin of sideways locomotion, with multiple independent reversions to forward locomotion in ecologically specialized groups. The species richness data show that the lineage in which sideways locomotion originated is far more diverse than its nearest outgroups. These results are consistent with the idea that sideways locomotion acted as a key innovation contributing to the evolutionary diversification of true crabs. Such a rare but innovative behavioral trait provides a framework for understanding how locomotor modes shape evolutionary diversification in animals.</jats:p>
items.summary: 《螃蟹侧向行走的演化》：该研究通过50种活体螃蟹的行为分析与系统发育比较，揭示侧向行走在真蟹中单次起源并多次独立逆转，且与物种多样性显著相关。值得阅读，因其首次阐明这一独特行为作为关键创新如何推动甲壳动物演化辐射，为理解运动模式与生物多样性关联提供新视角。
items.title: Evolution of sideways locomotion in crabs

items.abstract: <jats:p>Drug resistance inevitably emerges during the treatment of cancer by targeted therapy. Adaptive resistance is a major form of drug resistance, wherein the rewiring of protein signalling networks in response to drug perturbation allows drug-targeted protein activity to recover. This can occur in the continuous presence of the drug and enables cells to survive/grow. Simultaneously, molecular heterogeneity enables the selection of drug-resistant cancer clones that can survive an initial drug insult, proliferate, and eventually cause disease relapse. Despite their importance, the link between heterogeneity and adaptive resistance, specifically how heterogeneity influences protein signalling dynamics to drive adaptive resistance, remains poorly understood. Here, we have explored the relationship between heterogeneity, protein signalling dynamics, and adaptive resistance through the development of a novel modelling technique coined Meta Dynamic Network (MDN) modelling. We use MDN modelling to characterise how heterogeneity influences the drug-response signalling dynamics of the proteins that regulate early cell cycle progression and demonstrate that heterogeneity can robustly facilitate adaptive resistance associated dynamics for key cell cycle regulators. We determined the influence of heterogeneity at the level of both reaction coefficients and protein abundance and show that reaction coefficients are a much stronger driver of adaptive resistance. Owing to the mechanistic nature of the underpinning ordinary differential equation framework, we then identified a full spectrum of subnetworks capable of driving adaptive resistance dynamics in the key early cell cycle regulators. Finally, we show that single-cell dynamic data supports the validity of our MDN modelling technique and a comparison between our predicted resistance mechanisms and known CDK4/6 and oestrogen receptor inhibitor resistance mechanisms suggests MDN modelling can be deployed to robustly predict network-level resistance mechanisms for novel drugs and additional protein signalling networks.</jats:p>
items.summary: 《基于元动态网络建模的系统性分析揭示CDK4/6与雌激素受体抑制剂的网络驱动适应性耐药》：该研究提出新颖的元动态网络建模技术，系统阐明肿瘤异质性如何通过蛋白信号动态促进适应性耐药，并识别关键细胞周期调控子的耐药驱动子网络。值得阅读，因其为预测新型药物耐药机制提供了可推广的计算框架，对精准癌症治疗策略设计具有重要参考价值。
items.title: Systematic analysis of network-driven adaptive resistance to CDK4/6 and oestrogen receptor inhibition using meta-dynamic network modelling

items.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    The
                    <jats:italic>Drosophila</jats:italic>
                    scaffolding protein Zasp52 is required to maintain structure at the muscle Z-disc, which experiences strong forces during contraction. It is alternatively spliced into many isoforms, some of which contain a long intrinsically disordered region (IDR). We show that this region is primarily expressed in the indirect flight muscle (IFM) and is required for maintaining the integrity of the Z-disc. Deleting the IDR-encoding exon 15e results in flightlessness and structural IFM defects, including sarcomere bending at the Z-disc and an inability to de-contract. These defects are indicative of a lack of proper thin filament anchoring to the Z-disc. This is further supported by a genetic interaction between exon 15e and actin. Fluorescence recovery after photobleaching of an isoform lacking exon 15e shows that the IDR is required for maintaining Zasp52 at the Z-disc and thereby stabilizing Z-discs. Lastly, we can rescue these phenotypes by restricting IFM use. Together, these results suggest that Zasp52’s IDR confers thin filament stability at the Z-disc of IFM.
                  </jats:p>
items.summary: 《Zasp52差异表达的内在无序区赋予Z盘细丝稳定性》：该研究揭示果蝇Zasp52蛋白中特定无序区域在间接飞行肌中维持Z盘结构完整性的关键作用，通过基因敲除与荧光恢复实验证实其锚定细丝的功能。值得阅读，因其为理解肌肉收缩力学中蛋白动态调控提供了新视角，且对肌病机制研究具有启示意义。
items.title: Zasp52’s differentially expressed intrinsically disordered region confers thin filament stability at the Z-disc

items.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Landforms comprising mixtures of fine and coarse sediment and deposited during late glacial times are ubiquitous in the British mountains. In many cases, their interpretation has often proved contentious; as a result, the non‐generic term discrete debris accumulations (DDA) has been used to describe them and, over the last 50 years, some have been interpreted as fossil rock glaciers of late Quaternary age. However, detailed accounts of their sedimentology and structural assessments of surrounding rock slopes have been lacking, despite the insights into processes that such investigations would allow. Here, and for the first time in the British Isles, we use detailed lithological and structural modelling and analyses to investigate a well‐defined DDA in the Nantlle Valley of North Wales. We show that component clasts within the landform are from rockfall debris originally detached from upslope rockwalls above by relatively small‐scale failure events. The results of 2D rockfall analysis demonstrate that a significant proportion of component debris could not have been deposited directly from rockfall. Instead, we conclude that the DDA was formed by downslope remobilisation of thick talus deposits, and movement was associated with strong compressional flow in the frontal margin. We argue that the only plausible mechanism that could have been responsible was the internal creep of ground ice that had developed within the talus. As a result, we argue that the DDA is a fossil rock glacier. Its formation in western Britain with former high levels of precipitation calls into question some of the palaeoenvironmental implications often applied to such landforms.</jats:p>
items.summary: 《北威尔士南特勒河谷的岩屑石冰川》：该研究首次在不列颠群岛运用详细岩石学与结构建模，揭示该地貌由岩屑崩塌再移动形成，并论证其为化石石冰川。值得阅读，因其挑战了高降水环境下此类地貌的古环境解释，为冰川地貌研究提供新视角。
items.title: A talus rock glacier in Nantlle Valley, North Wales

items.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    A detailed morphometric analysis of 200 cirques across the western Putorana Plateau, central Siberia, was undertaken to investigate cirque development, reconstruct glaciers and infer palaeoclimatic conditions. Cirques are amphitheatre‐shaped landforms with mean length and widths of 936 and 1000 m, respectively, indicating a mature glacial landscape shaped by prolonged erosion. Cirques exhibit near‐circularity (mean ratio 1.05) and a width–height ratio (3.44), indicating their characteristics of wider‐than‐deep form, with significant erosion of headwalls. Strong positive correlations between length, width and height (L/W: 0.758; L/H: 0.610) suggest that these dimensions scale together. A dominant northwesterly aspect reflects climatic conditions under which the cirques formed. PalaeoIce 2.0 reconstructions indicate that cirque glaciers generated a total reconstructed ice volume of 10.6 km
                    <jats:sup>3</jats:sup>
                    . Reconstructed glaciers attained a median ice thickness of 55.9 m and a maximum of 260.6 m, whilst equilibrium‐line altitudes reconstructed using the AAR and AABR methods ranged from 593 to 1372 m a.s.l. with median values of 818–826 m a.s.l. Strong positive correlations between glacier thickness and cirque dimensions indicate that basin geometry exerted a control on ice accumulation. Using the reconstructed ELAs, a snowline depression was calculated relative to present‐day conditions. Estimated temperature depressions range from 5.0 to 5.7 °C under mean conditions, and up to 7.2 °C under the coldest scenarios. This corresponds to summer temperatures of 0.3 to −0.4 °C and annual temperatures of −14.7 to −15.4 °C. Estimated palaeoprecipitation values of 875–1036 mm a
                    <jats:sup>−1</jats:sup>
                    suggest that sufficient moisture was needed to sustain cirque‐style glaciation. These findings provide the first quantitative reconstruction of cirque glaciers in the western Putorana Plateau and demonstrate that the region supported mountain glaciation during cold stages of the Late Pleistocene. This study provides new constraints on former glacier extent, equilibrium‐line altitudes and palaeoclimatic conditions, contributing to a broader understanding of mountain glaciations across Siberia.
                  </jats:p>
items.summary: 《西西伯利亚普托拉纳高原西部冰斗的形态计量分析：古气候代用指标》：该研究对200个冰斗进行形态测量并重建古冰川，首次定量揭示该区域晚更新世冰川规模与气候条件，为理解西伯利亚山地冰川演化提供关键数据，值得关注。
items.title: Morphometric analysis of cirques in central Siberia's western Putorana Plateau: a proxy for palaeoclimate
